source_text: Vidi Dominum sedentem super thronum excelsum et elevatum. Non omnis qui videt Dominum videt eum in throno excelso — Daniel throni positi; in valle Iosaphat iudicaturus. Aliquando Deus sursum aliquando deorsum iuxta dignitatem. Plena domus gloria eius — non haec terrena plenitudo gloriae Dei.
pass_a_gloss: I-saw Lord sitting upon throne high and lifted. Not every who sees Lord sees him on throne high — Daniel thrones placed; in valley Jehoshaphat about-to-judge. Sometimes God above sometimes below according-to dignity. Full house with-glory his — not this earthly fullness of-glory of-God.
pass_b_english: [[I saw the Lord seated on a throne high and lifted up >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]]. Not everyone who sees the Lord sees him on a high throne — Daniel saw [[thrones set >> Bible:Daniel 7:9]]; in Jehoshaphat’s valley he sits to judge. God is seen above or below according to the matter’s worth. [[The house was full of his glory >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]] — not this earthly fullness of God’s glory.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Isaiah homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
